Name: Turn Clint into a second Emily
Author: lhijazi
Description:
[size=5]Tired of looking at Clint? A big Emily stan? Yes? Boy do I have a mod for you[/size]


[size=4]Changes all sprites and portraits of Clint into Emily. Thats it. Made as result of a joke in the SDV discord and me being bored. Seriously though, if you want a good Clint replacer try [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3736]Clarice[/url], a much better and extensive mod that deletes Clint in favor of someone who is infinitely cooler than he is

[/size]Requires [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and then just drag and drop the extracted folder into your mods folder

While you're reading this, check out my other, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1354]actual good mod[/url]! It adds in a bunch of new shirts to the character creator
